title: Migrate player export records from TypedDict to dataclasses
description:
Replace the player export records in `schemas/game_export_types.py` with dataclasses: `Player` and `PilotPlayer`. Fold `_PlayerRequired` and `_PlayerOptionalFields` into this same migration instead of treating them as separate issues.

Update `is_pilot_player()` and the export/leaderboard/analysis consumers that rely on player records. Keep root export container work out of this PR.

The review target is a single player-model migration, not a larger `GameExport` rewrite.
